faq_without_cad_question: No 3D CAD files? Can you still build our vehicle?
faq_without_cad_answer: Yes. We have developed a workflow to build accurate vehicle digital twins from reference images alone. We recreate the vehicle’s proportions, surfaces, materials and details, including the features specific to your market. Share the images you have, and we will guide you on any additional views needed to build a faithful match.
